We build software that helps companies along the food system get to Net Zero.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. 🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success as a trusted advisor and account manager for our enterprise customers. Own a portfolio end-to-end from onboarding and tool adoption through retention and ARR growth, co-developing new value propositions and building the trust-based relationships that turn customers into advocates.
 

Over the next 12 months you will:

  1. Grow annual contract values of existing enterprise customers

    • Translate our impact into tangible business value for economic buyers.

    • Lead renewal negotiations and drive upsell opportunities with existing customers.

    • Expand our reach within global enterprises across new regions, teams, and decision-makers.

  2. Support customers' progress along their climate journey

    • Build and nurture strong relationships with clients as their trusted climate advisor and single point of contact, coordinating internal expertise to deliver clear, actionable guidance on sustainability topics

    • Educate users and guide them toward measurable progress on their Net Zero journey.

  3. Boost farm-level data collection via the RootOS platform

    • Onboard sustainability managers, farm technicians, and farmers to the platform and guide their data collection efforts.

    • Ensure high data integrity, partner with trusted farm-level data sources, and meet data coverage targets.

    • Collect, consolidate, and prioritize product feedback.

Wir beteiligen uns am Leasing deines Cargo Bikes . Regelmäßige Company Events sowie kostenlose Kalt- und Heißgetränke. Auch Observability, Networking, Compute-Tuning, Auto-Remediation, Security-kritische Infrastrukturen und Multi-Site-Cloud-Umgebungen gehören zu deinem technischen Erfahrungsspektrum. Gleichzeitig teilst du dein Wissen gerne und kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge klar vermitteln. Wir arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld auf Englisch . title: Data Protection & AI Governance Advisor (m/w/d)
description: Your mission Datenschutz Du unterstützt unsere Business Funktionen bei der Dokumentation ihrer Verarbeitungsprozessen und pflegst die Verzeichnisse nach Art. 30 Abs. 1 + 2 DSGVO. Du erstellst Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments. Du berätst die Fachbereiche zur datenschutzrechtlichen Ausgestaltung unserer SaaS-Produkte und internen Prozesse – insbesondere zu Datenminimierung, Mandantentrennung, Berechtigungskonzepten, Löschung und Privacy by Design. Du prüfst Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge und führst Vorabprüfungen neuer Dienstleister und KI-Tools durch. Du betreibst das Datenschutzmanagementsystem: Du pflegst Richtlinien und Vorlagen, führst Kontrollen durch, überwachst Abhilfemaßnahmen und verwaltest unsere Datenschutz- und KI-Governanceplattform. AI Governance Du baust das Inventar unserer KI-Systeme auf und pflegst es, bereitest die Einordnung nach Art. 6 und Anhang III AI Act vor und bestimmst unsere Rolle als Anbieter oder Betreiber. Du wirkst am Freigabeprozess für KI-Vorhaben mit und entwickelst Prüfkriterien, Gates und Entscheidungsvorlagen. Du erstellst die Pflichtdokumentation zu Risikomanagement, Daten-Governance und Bias-Prüfung, technischer Dokumentation, menschlicher Aufsicht, Protokollierung sowie Transparenzpflichten. Du prüfst KI-Modelle und -Dienste auf vertragliche Zusagen zu Trainingsnutzung, Datenhaltung und Vereinbarkeit mit unseren Kundenzusagen. So arbeiten wir zusammen Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, das pragmatisch denkt und eng mit Produkt, Engineering und Legal zusammenarbeitet. Wir schätzen offenen Austausch, kurze Wege und die gemeinsame Freude daran, komplexe Regulatorik in praktikable Lösungen zu übersetzen. Your profile Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Datenschutz mit, davon substanziell in einer Second-Line-Funktion – etwa als Datenschutzkoordinator, im Datenschutzmanagement, in einer Compliance- oder Governance-Einheit oder in einer externen Beratungsrolle mit vergleichbarem Prüfauftrag. Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments. Du gehst sicher mit der DSGVO auf Normebene um, kennst die EDSA-Leitlinien und bist vertraut mit der Rechtsprechung zu Drittlandtransfers und Verantwortlichkeit. Du hast erste belegbare Berührungspunkte mit KI-Governance und dem EU AI Act – etwa durch Klassifizierung von KI-Systemen, Bewertung von LLM-gestützten Funktionen, Modell- oder Bias-Prüfungen, Erstellung von Transparenzhinweisen oder Mitarbeit an einer KI-Richtlinie. Du musst keine vollständige AI-Act-Routine mitbringen; die Bereitschaft, dir diese Tiefe bei uns aufzubauen, genügt uns. Du arbeitest strukturiert und verlässlich mit hoher Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher. Wünschenswert: Du hast ein juristisches Studium abgeschlossen sowie eine Zertifizierung wie etwa IAPP CIPP/E, CIPM oder AIGP erworben. Für Juristinnen und Juristen: Du strebst eine Zulassung als Syndikusrechtsanwältin oder Syndikusrechtsanwalt an? Wir unterstützen dich aktiv dabei – sowohl im Zulassungsverfahren als auch bei der fachlichen Ausgestaltung deiner Rolle. Why us Weil wir Talent höher bewerten als Hierarchien.   • Own Bus, the CDK, and the core stack. Features, tests, CI, releases, and deprecations across the connectors already running in production.

  • Make the docs good enough to remove yourself. An outside contributor should be able to build a connector on our libraries without a call.

  • Deep Python: 5+ years of writing production Python other people depend on. Async, typing, packaging, testing. You've designed APIs that other engineers built on, not just glue code.

  • SiLA 2, or another device abstraction and interoperability standard

  • Lab automation, scientific instruments, or a life science background

  • C, C++, .NET, or Rust, for the vendor DLLs and drivers we end up wrapping

description: Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.   At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.    Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!   We are currently looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group.   This is a highly commercial, individual contributor role focused on identifying growth opportunities, rapidly testing concepts, and developing them into scalable initiatives. You’ll take ownership of new growth ideas from initial concept through to live testing and early-stage optimisation, before transitioning successful initiatives to the relevant teams for scaling. Working at the intersection of brand, data, experimentation and AI, you’ll combine strong analytical thinking with practical execution to turn insights into measurable business impact. Please note this is a fixed-term (maternity cover) role for up to 18 months. What you will do Identify, prioritise and model new growth opportunities across audiences, propositions, channels and customer journeys, including clear forecasts, assumptions and risks. Rapidly test and soft-launch new initiatives or channels, nurturing them until they are proven and ready to transition to the relevant teams for scaling. Own high-impact projects end-to-end, using data and a full-funnel, customer-focused approach to uncover insights and drive growth. Move projects forward through ambiguity, maintaining pace from concept to launch and handover while capturing learnings to inform future activity. Leverage AI, GPT tools and automation to improve speed, quality and decision-making, while building or refining workflows to increase efficiency and scalability. Continuously identify inefficiencies and opportunities, helping to improve ways of working and elevate how AI is used in day-to-day growth activities. What you should bring Strong experience in growth, digital or performance marketing within a fast-paced ecommerce or consumer business. A proven track record of hands-on delivery, with the ability to build and launch initiatives from scratch rather than only oversee them. Excellent analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to model opportunities and assess their potential impact. A naturally curious, self-starting mindset, with a willingness to explore, problem-solve and operate without a predefined playbook. Practical experience using AI tools, GPTs or automation to enhance output, efficiency or insight. The ability to work independently, collaborate across teams and drive progress without reliance on hierarchy. A strong belief in linking brand activity to measurable business outcomes, and the ability to help demonstrate that impact. What we can offer you A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events. Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun. Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration. Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company. Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally. Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. Aufgaben

  • Als Kreditanalyst Finanzierung & Leasing (m/w/d) prüfen und bearbeiten Sie Kreditanfragen und begleiten diese von der Analyse bis zur Genehmigung
  • Zudem bewerten Sie Kredit- und Risikodaten, bereiten Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und überwachen bestehende Kreditengagements

Qualifikation

  • Grundlage bildet eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Bankkaufmann (m/w/d), Kaufmann für Versicherungen und Finanzanlagen (m/w/d) oder Industriekaufmann (m/w/d)
  • Sie bringen Berufserfahrung als Kreditanalyst (m/w/d), Kreditsachbearbeiter (m/w/d) oder Credit Analyst (m/w/d) mit, idealerweise in der Kreditprüfung, Finanzierung oder im Risikomanagement

Benefits

  • Finanzexpertise – aber außerhalb klassischer Bankstrukturen: Nutzen Sie Ihre Erfahrung aus Kreditprüfung, Finanzierung oder Risikomanagement in einem namhaften Unternehmen
  • Flexibilität: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell
  • Sicherheit: Befristeter Arbeitsvertrag im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung
  • Weiterentwicklung: Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Team-Spirit: Sympathische Kollegen, wertschätzendes Miteinander und kurze Entscheidungswege

Dabei bist du es gewohnt, Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen, kreative Lösungen zu entwickeln und diese überzeugend zu präsentieren. Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Creative Pitches: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Präsentation von Creative Pitches und weißt, wie man kreative Ideen strukturiert, visuell ansprechend aufbereitet und Kunden überzeugend präsentiert. title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
description: (Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken. They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place. Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel. (Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

description: A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset. At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc). Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action. We are looking for a Climate Asset Development Lead (f/d/m) , You will lead CEEZER’s expansion into climate performance assets by owning our strategy and deal execution across EAC, SAFc, and the secondary carbon market. Starting as a team of one, you'll drive supply origination, provide market expertise to clients, and scale your team alongside business growth. Your mission Setting up the strategy for climate performance asset supply access across EAC, SAFc, and the secondary carbon market. Evaluate and end-to-end drive the expansion of CEEZER in new climate performance assets, from market assessment to transaction. Run the trading of climate performance assets: Ensure supply access, execute deals hands-on, negotiate prices & contracts, and structure complex transactions. Lead and grow the Climate Asset Development team, starting with our Climate Asset Trader, setting priorities and building the team as volume grows. Establish CEEZER's thought leadership on EAC and SAFc, provide expert insights and ensure the latest policy and market trends translate into strategy and execution company-wide. Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, registries, and regulatory bodies and act as our subject-matter expert in client conversations. Drive company-wide projects and collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Revenue, Supply, Operations, and Product. Collect and structure data, collect quotes, and collaborate with data platforms and intelligence providers as a basis for analyses, forecasts, and decision-making. What you need to succeed 4+ years of experience in strategy consulting, VC-backed startups, or similar high-performance environments. Experience with any climate performance assets, trading, or energy markets is a plus. Exceptional analytical skill set with attention to detail. Executional excellence balanced with speed, and comfort taking measured risks within a defined framework. Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, strong in building relationships with heterogeneous stakeholders internally and externally. Leadership experience is a plus. High ownership, accountability, and integrity, paired with willingness to learn and grow. Strong business acumen and commercial hunger. Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in business, economics, finance, international relations, environmental studies or a related field is a plus. Fluency in English is required. A valid work permit in Germany. The hiring process An intro call with the People Team. A call with our SVP Sourcing & Delivery, Stephan. A call with our Climate Asset Trader, Pietro. A deep-dive case study with our SVP Sourcing & Delivery and additional stakeholders. What's in it for you at CEEZER? A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets. Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence. True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it. An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise. Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management. A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate. Create an impact with us We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you. Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive. If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you. About us CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. title: Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) - Produkt & Praxis-Digitalisierung
description: Mediform entwickelt digitale Produkte für Arztpraxen – bekannt geworden durch MediVoice, einen der führenden KI-Telefonassistenten für Arztpraxen in Deutschland. Wir bauen unser Produktportfolio gerade gezielt aus, um die Digitalisierung von Praxen über den Telefonassistenten hinaus voranzutreiben. Für diese Rolle suchen wir dich: einen Medizinstudenten / eine Medizinstudentin mit erster praktischer Erfahrung in der Patientenversorgung (nach dem 1. Staatsexamen, z. B. durch Famulaturen), der/die Lust hat, die Digitalisierung von Arztpraxen aktiv mitzugestalten. Du bringst dein Praxiswissen direkt in unsere Produktentwicklung ein – über unser gesamtes, wachsendes Produktportfolio hinweg – und trägst gleichzeitig dazu bei, dass Praxen einfacher, moderner und effizienter arbeiten können. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produktteam zusammen, remote mit flexiblem Standort – idealerweise mit Sitz in Karlsruhe für gelegentliche Abstimmungen vor Ort. Aufgaben Du bringst Insights aus dem echten Praxisalltag (Abläufe, Pain Points, Bedürfnisse von Ärzt*innen und Praxispersonal) in unsere Produktentwicklung ein – nicht nur für MediVoice, sondern für unser gesamtes Produktportfolio. Du hilfst dabei, neue Features und Produkte aus medizinischer Perspektive zu bewerten und mitzugestalten. Du unterstützt bei der Erhebung und Auswertung von Nutzerfeedback aus Praxen (Interviews, Gespräche, strukturierte Auswertungen). Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung bestehender und neuer Produkte mit, damit unsere Lösungen noch besser auf die Realität in Arztpraxen einzahlen. Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt, Tech und ggf. Customer Success zusammen, um Anforderungen aus der Praxis in konkrete Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen. Qualifikation Medizinstudium , mindestens nach dem 1. Staatsexamen. Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Patientenversorgung (Famulatur, PJ, Nebenjob in einer Praxis/Klinik o. Ä.). Echtes Interesse an Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen und Lust, Prozesse aus der Praxis heraus zu verbessern. Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise – besonders im Remote-Setting. Hohe Affinität zu KI und Bereitschaft, KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen. Verfügbarkeit von 15–20 Stunden pro Woche (flexibel einteilbar, in Semesterferien gerne mehr). Optional : Interesse, Praktika oder Abschlussarbeiten mit Praxisbezug bei uns einzubringen – wir unterstützen dich dabei. Sprachkenntnisse Deutsch: Muttersprache oder mindestens Niveau B2 Englisch: Fließend Benefits Remote-first mit flexiblem Standort – idealerweise Karlsruhe für gelegentliche Abstimmungen vor Ort. Flexible Arbeitszeiten , kompatibel mit Klinik- und Studienalltag. Urban Sports Club Abo – für Sport und Ausgleich, flexibel nutzbar. Hoher Impact – deine Praxiserfahrung fließt direkt in Produktentscheidungen ein, die tausenden Arztpraxen zugutekommen. Direkter Zugang zu Produktentwicklung, Tech und Gründerteam – und Einblick in den Aufbau eines wachsenden Produktportfolios. Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Betreuung von Praktika, Bachelor- oder Masterarbeiten mit Praxisbezug. Ein junges, motiviertes Team , das sinnvolle Health-Tech-Produkte entwickelt. Warum diese Rolle? Kaum jemand kennt den Praxisalltag so gut wie jemand, der ihn selbst erlebt hat. Genau dieses Wissen fehlt vielen Produktteams in der Digital-Health-Branche – bei uns bringst du es direkt ein, und zwar nicht nur für ein Produkt, sondern für ein ganzes, wachsendes Portfolio. Du übersetzt medizinische Realität in Produktentscheidungen und siehst, wie deine Impulse tatsächlich im Produkt landen. Bewerbung & Nächste Schritte Wie geht es weiter? Wir melden uns zeitnah bei dir. Wenn uns deine Unterlagen überzeugen, laden wir dich zu einem kurzen Video-Call mit uns ein, um uns kennenzulernen und offene Fragen zu klären. Deine Bewerbung: Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben . Erzähl uns, welche praktische Erfahrung du bislang in Praxen oder Kliniken gesammelt hast und was dir dabei besonders aufgefallen ist – positiv wie negativ. Bonus-Challenge (optional): Beschreibe uns eine konkrete Situation aus deiner bisherigen Praxiserfahrung, in der ein digitales Tool (oder das Fehlen eines solchen) den Ablauf spürbar erleichtert oder erschwert hat.   • Du bringst Insights aus dem echten Praxisalltag (Abläufe, Pain Points, Bedürfnisse von Ärzt*innen und Praxispersonal) in unsere Produktentwicklung ein – nicht nur für MediVoice, sondern für unser gesamtes Produktportfolio.
  • Du hilfst dabei, neue Features und Produkte aus medizinischer Perspektive zu bewerten und mitzugestalten.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Erhebung und Auswertung von Nutzerfeedback aus Praxen (Interviews, Gespräche, strukturierte Auswertungen).
  • Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung bestehender und neuer Produkte mit, damit unsere Lösungen noch besser auf die Realität in Arztpraxen einzahlen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt, Tech und ggf. Customer Success zusammen, um Anforderungen aus der Praxis in konkrete Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen.

Qualifikation

  • Medizinstudium, mindestens nach dem 1. Staatsexamen.
  • Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Patientenversorgung (Famulatur, PJ, Nebenjob in einer Praxis/Klinik o. Ä.).
  • Echtes Interesse an Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen und Lust, Prozesse aus der Praxis heraus zu verbessern.
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise – besonders im Remote-Setting.
  • Hohe Affinität zu KI und Bereitschaft, KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen.
  • Verfügbarkeit von 15–20 Stunden pro Woche (flexibel einteilbar, in Semesterferien gerne mehr).
  • Optional: Interesse, Praktika oder Abschlussarbeiten mit Praxisbezug bei uns einzubringen – wir unterstützen dich dabei.

Sprachkenntnisse

  • Deutsch: Muttersprache oder mindestens Niveau B2
  • Englisch: Fließend

Benefits

  • Remote-first mit flexiblem Standort – idealerweise Karlsruhe für gelegentliche Abstimmungen vor Ort.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, kompatibel mit Klinik- und Studienalltag.
  • Urban Sports Club Abo – für Sport und Ausgleich, flexibel nutzbar.
  • Hoher Impact – deine Praxiserfahrung fließt direkt in Produktentscheidungen ein, die tausenden Arztpraxen zugutekommen.
  • Direkter Zugang zu Produktentwicklung, Tech und Gründerteam – und Einblick in den Aufbau eines wachsenden Produktportfolios.
  • Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Betreuung von Praktika, Bachelor- oder Masterarbeiten mit Praxisbezug.
  • Ein junges, motiviertes Team, das sinnvolle Health-Tech-Produkte entwickelt.

Warum diese Rolle?

Kaum jemand kennt den Praxisalltag so gut wie jemand, der ihn selbst erlebt hat. Genau dieses Wissen fehlt vielen Produktteams in der Digital-Health-Branche – bei uns bringst du es direkt ein, und zwar nicht nur für ein Produkt, sondern für ein ganzes, wachsendes Portfolio. Du übersetzt medizinische Realität in Produktentscheidungen und siehst, wie deine Impulse tatsächlich im Produkt landen.

Bewerbung & Nächste Schritte

Wie geht es weiter? Wir melden uns zeitnah bei dir. Wenn uns deine Unterlagen überzeugen, laden wir dich zu einem kurzen Video-Call mit uns ein, um uns kennenzulernen und offene Fragen zu klären.

Deine Bewerbung: Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben. Erzähl uns, welche praktische Erfahrung du bislang in Praxen oder Kliniken gesammelt hast und was dir dabei besonders aufgefallen ist – positiv wie negativ.

Bonus-Challenge (optional): Beschreibe uns eine konkrete Situation aus deiner bisherigen Praxiserfahrung, in der ein digitales Tool (oder das Fehlen eines solchen) den Ablauf spürbar erleichtert oder erschwert hat.

description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche. Für unsere Marke Tamaris suchen wir im Bereich Operations zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als Werkstudent E-Commerce & Retail Operations (m/w/d). Was Sie bei uns bewegen: Unterstützung des Bereiches E-Commerce & Retail Operations im Tagesgeschäft Mitarbeit bei (Teil‑)Projekten im E‑Commerce‑, Retail‑ und Omnichannel‑Umfeld und bei Fulfillment-, Lager- und Transportprozessen Eigenständige Optimierung und Automatisierung von Prozessen, auch durch den Einsatz moderner Tools und KI‑basierter Auswertungen Was uns ausmacht: Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur. Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung. Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen. Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits. Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine. Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße. Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de. Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur. Was Sie ausmacht: Eingeschriebene/r Student/in der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder E-Commerce Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Bereitschaft, sich in neue Themen und Anwendungen einzuarbeiten Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Freude an der Gestaltung, Optimierung und Automatisierung von Prozessen Interesse an Digitalisierung, modernen Tools und KI-basierten Lösungen Sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office Produkten Sie sind ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzen die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen. description: Location : Fully Remote (Global) Classification : Full-time; 40 hours per week Pay Range : €51,000-90,000 Experience : 2+ years as a QA engineer Welcome to Miaplaza! Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy , Always Icecream , and Clever Dragons , and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School . Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀 ▶️ You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future ! How you’ll make an impact (position summary): Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful! The Role We're looking for a QA Engineer to join our current QA team. You'll take ownership of how we test, validate, and sign off on quality across our platform. We're actively investing in our QA practice: expanding automated test coverage, improving our release testing process, and moving toward a model where quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle. You'll report to a technical Engineering Manager and work alongside engineers who value clear test documentation, reliable automation, and confident code releases. As a mature company, we have legacy systems and established manual testing workflows, but we are transitioning to modern automated testing practices using Playwright and TypeScript. The split between manual and automated work varies, but you should be comfortable working across both, bringing automation where it adds the most value while pragmatically maintaining manual coverage where it's still the right tool. A core goal of our QA evolution is to make testing faster, more reliable, and less dependent on last-minute changes before each release: replacing fragile manual regression cycles with stable automated suites, reducing flakiness, and building coverage that the whole team can rely on. Every testing investment is measured by whether it improves quality and reduces the team's burden at release time. What You'll Do Write and maintain automated regression tests; review automation MRs from peers Execute manual testing across web UIs (functional, regression, cross-platform, responsive layouts on mobile/tablet) Create and maintain test cases, checklists, and test documentation in TestRail File clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps; collaborate with developers to triage and resolve Own the release testing process to ensure only high-quality changes ship Partner with PMs and designers on requirements review, edge cases, and acceptance criteria Contribute to QA process improvements as we scale (currently a 2-person team growing to 4) How We Work We believe you should know what your days look like before you accept an offer. We don't have much bureaucracy. Small team, direct communication, short decision loops. If you've worked at places where opening a Jira ticket to request a Jira ticket was normal, this isn't that. Here's the reality: Meetings (yes, we keep them minimal): Daily standup with your product team. Show up, share updates and unblock each other.. Sprint planning and retrospectives with your product team, once per sprint. 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda. Monthly Engineering all-hands. That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work. Deployments: Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release. Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes Communication: Async-friendly. Documentation-first. Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion Google Workspace for email and documents. Zoom for video calls. Timezone: We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet. What We're Looking For Requirements (Requisite Skills):  2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer) 2+ years of experience using TypeScript Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication Strong experience in manual testing and writing manual test cases Nice to have: Experience with accessibility and/or security testing How you’ll work with other teams: Career Growth We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there. Onboarding Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza. What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to. Interview Process Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check in accordance with applicable law. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help. Compensation Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides. Ready to apply? Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves a screening call, followed by a behavioral interview, and two technical interviews.   • 1:1 with your Engineering Manager - Regular cadence, your agenda.

  • Monthly Engineering all-hands.

  • That's it. The rest of your time is yours to work.

Deployments:

  • Bi-monthly release cadence with a schedule published in advance. As a QA Engineer, you own the release testing window. Coordinating with developers, running regression suites, and signing off on quality before the release.

  • Infrequent ad-hoc hotfixes

Communication:

  • Async-friendly. Documentation-first.

  • Slack/ Jira/ GitLab MRs/ Notion

  • Google Workspace for email and documents.

  • Zoom for video calls.

Timezone:

  • We need significant overlap with typical CET (Central European Time) working hours to coordinate and collaborate synchronously. Additionally we have stakeholders and developers in US timezones that we occasionally need to meet.


What We're Looking For

Requirements (Requisite Skills): 

  • 2+ years of QA engineering experience, including web UI testing

  • 2+ years of experience with Playwright or a similar test automation framework (e.g. Cypress, Selenium, Puppeteer)

  • 2+ years of experience using TypeScript

  • Strong test design skills: comfortable writing and maintaining test cases, checklists, and test documentation

  • Familiarity with QA's role in the SDLC and how to collaborate with developers and PMs

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Upper-intermediate English (B2+) for written and spoken communication

  • Strong experience in manual testing and writing manual test cases

Nice to have:

  • Experience with accessibility and/or security testing

How you’ll work with other teams:

Career Growth

We have a defined career ladder. Whether your path leads toward Senior/Staff QA Engineer or Engineering Management, there's room to grow - and we'll work with you to get there.

Onboarding

Every team member gets full support throughout onboarding, and no one expects you to figure out the ins and outs on your own. We'll pair with you, answer every question, and make sure you have the context you need. New hires typically feel very supported at Miaplaza.

What success looks like here: In the first couple of months, you're asking a lot of clarifying questions, reading documentation, exploring the product independently, and writing and running tests with confidence. By months 3-4, you're taking ownership of a specific area, building out test coverage, identifying gaps, and driving quality improvements. By month 5-6, you're contributing meaningfully to the testing strategy for migration and modernisation work and operating independently. The common thread: curiosity, initiative, and the habit of investigating before you ask, but always asking when you need to.

Interview Process

Our process is staged and designed to respect your time. Expect a mix of introductory conversation, technical discussion, and practical evaluation. We want to understand how you think about real problems and testing practices. As part of the process, we will ask for professional references and conduct a background check in accordance with applicable law. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, let us know, we're happy to help.

Compensation

Competitive compensation, open to negotiation based on your experience and expertise. We'll discuss specifics early in the process so neither side wastes time. Since we’re remote-first, every arrangement is different; we tailor time off, benefits, and perks as part of your individual contract to ensure the overall package works for both sides.

What we offer

  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and a collaborative engineering culture


Your mission

Join our robotics team working on autonomous systems that operate as coordinated, distributed agents in real-world environments. 

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the development and validation of our multi-UAV system, with a particular focus on software tooling, simulation, and system observability. 

Depending on your background and the project, you may also contribute to areas such as SLAM, navigation, perception, planning, or multi-agent coordination. This is a hands-on internship where you will develop and test software, work with real robotic systems, and see how your work performs beyond simulation. 

  • Develop data-driven dashboards and tools to monitor, analyze, and visualize system performance
  • Extend our simulation framework with KPIs, automated scenarios, and evaluation workflows
  • Analyze simulation and field-test data to identify issues and opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to the core robotics stack in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or mission execution
  • Collaborate closely with robotics, simulation, embedded, and domain experts
  • Gain practical experience developing and validating software for complex autonomous systems


Your profile

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Autonomous Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Good programming skills in C++, ideally modern C++ (17/20)
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering
  • Basic understanding of robotics concepts such as coordinate frames, sensor data, estimation, planning, or control
  • Comfortable working in Linux
  • Curious about complex roboticsystems and motivated to understand how things work beyond your individual component
  • Able to work independently on a defined technical problem while actively seeking feedback when needed
  • Genuine interest in autonomous systems, robotics, and defense technology


Nice to have

You do not need to bring all of these — experience from university projects, research, student teams, personal projects, or previous internships counts. 

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2
  • Experience with real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups
  • Exposure to SLAM, navigation, computer vision, estimation, filtering, planning, or control
  • Interest or experience in multi-agent systems, swarming, or distributed robotics
  • Experience working with LiDAR or camera data
  • Exposure to PX4 or ArduPilot
  • Experience with simulation frameworks such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or Unreal Engine
  • Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or networking
  • Exposure to machine learning methods


What else

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn
  • Structured and reliable way of working
  • Comfortable working in an environment where not every problem has a predefined solution
  • Collaborative and open to technical feedback
  • High ethical standards and disciplined workethic
  • Extra-curricular engineering projects, robotics competitions, research, or other technical achievements are a plus

The practical part 

  • Duration: 3–6 months, full-time
  • Eligibility: NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required

title: Head of Social
description: About the Role: Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, the Head of Social will be responsible for defining and driving TALA’s organic social strategy and growth agenda across our key social channels. You will lead our social team, setting the strategic direction, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring our social channels build brand awareness, cultural relevance, community and channel growth. You will balance creativity with data and commercial thinking, ensuring we are not just creating content, but building a social presence that drives the business forward. You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, Influencer, PR, Product and Ecommerce teams, ensuring social is connected to the wider marketing strategy and that TALA continues to be ahead of the conversation. We’re looking for a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable setting the direction, managing a team and getting into the details when needed. Tasks Day to day this looks like: Social Strategy: Own and evolve TALA’s organic social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, with oversight of Pinterest and LinkedIn, setting clear objectives, channel roles, audiences, content pillars and KPIs. Growth Strategy: Identify opportunities to grow TALA’s social audience, reach and relevance, developing strategies to increase awareness, engagement and community. Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment. Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Provide clear strategic direction and briefs to the content creators within the team, ensuring content is distinctive, relevant, engaging and effective against our KPIs. Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel. Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth. Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches. Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy. Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works. Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy. Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience. Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets. Requirements You should: Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand. Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team. Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce. Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach. Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth. Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn. Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations. Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel. Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts. Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture. Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams. Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment. Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources. Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required. Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth. Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease. When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear.   • Build and own TALA’s VIP strategy, identifying the people who can meaningfully increase awareness, desirability and cultural relevance.
  • Develop relationships with celebrities, musicians, stylists, athletes, tastemakers and influential cultural figures.
  • Bring a strong existing network and continually build TALA’s VIP black book.
  • Create strategic partnerships that go beyond gifting from organic product placement to collaborations, appearances and brand moments.
  • Ensure TALA is consistently seen on the right people, in the right places and at the right cultural moments.

Ambassador & Pro Programmes

  • Own the strategy, vision and evolution of TALA’s Ambassador and Pro programmes.
  • Define the role these programmes play within TALA’s broader brand and awareness strategy, including who we want to attract, why they matter and what we want them to deliver.
  • Establish the programme proposition, structure, tiers, criteria and long-term growth strategy.
  • Together with the team, build a best-in-class network of ambassadors and professional athletes who genuinely align with TALA and can become powerful advocates for the brand.
  • Set the strategic direction for recruitment, relationship development, activation and retention, with the team responsible for day-to-day programme management and execution.
  • Continuously assess and evolve the programmes based on KPIs including brand impact, reach, engagement and commercial contribution.

Influencer

  • Own the overall influencer strategy, defining how influencer partnerships drive awareness, cultural relevance, desirability and growth.
  • Set the direction for the talent TALA works with, from high-profile creators and cultural tastemakers to emerging talent and community voices.
  • Identify opportunities to move beyond traditional influencer activity into cultural partnerships, organic product placement and high-impact moments.
  • Ensure influencer strategy is integrated with VIP, Ambassador, Pro, PR, gifting, social and campaign activity.
  • Set clear KPIs and continuously evolve the strategy based on performance and cultural opportunity.

Gifting

  • Own the strategic direction for TALA gifting, transforming it from a reactive PR function into a significant awareness and brand-building engine.
  • Together with the team, define who TALA should be gifting, when, why and what we want gifting to achieve.
  • Oversee the strategy for key product launches, cultural moments, VIP gifting, stylist seeding and wider brand moments.
  • Lead the team in developing, signing off and executing gifting programmes, ensuring activity ladders back to wider brand and campaign priorities.

PR

  • Together with the Brand Marketing Director own the overall PR strategy and communications agenda for TALA.
  • Define the role of PR within the wider brand strategy and how it will contribute to building fame, credibility and awareness.
  • Set the annual PR strategy, priorities, narratives and key cultural moments, working closely with Brand Marketing, Social, Influencer and Product.
  • Brief the PR agency to establish the types of stories TALA should be known for and proactively identify opportunities to create news rather than simply respond to it.
  • Ensure the PR team and agency has a clear roadmap and empower them to execute against it.

Events & Experiences

  • Own the TALA events and experiences strategy, defining how physical brand experiences can drive awareness, desirability, community and growth.
  • Set the annual events strategy, including the role of VIP events, consumer experiences, cultural moments, product launches, retail activations and larger-scale brand moments.
  • Define what makes a TALA experience distinctive and ensure every activation is rooted in the brand and designed to generate impact beyond the room.
  • Identify and feed into the events team opportunities for TALA to create culturally relevant moments that can extend into PR, social and organic conversation.
  • Oversee the brief and objectives for key events, with the team responsible for planning and delivering the experience.
  • Oversee the evaluation of the effectiveness of events against awareness, reach, brand impact and commercial objectives, continually evolving the approach.

Requirements

About You

We’re looking for someone who is highly connected, culturally switched-on and relentlessly ambitious.

You will likely have:

  • Significant experience across VIP, celebrity, influencers, PR and events within fashion, beauty, lifestyle or a culturally relevant consumer brand.
  • A strong existing network of VIPs, stylists, agents, managers, media and cultural tastemakers.
  • A proven ability to build authentic relationships with high-profile talent.
  • Experience creating campaigns and moments that generate significant awareness and organic conversation.
  • Strong commercial and strategic thinking, understanding that awareness must ultimately contribute to brand and business growth.
  • A strong understanding of culture, fashion, music, TV, sport, entertainment and what makes people talk.
  • An instinct for what feels cool, relevant and TALA.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and negotiation skills.
  • The confidence to challenge the status quo and create ideas that haven't been done before.
  • A highly proactive, entrepreneurial approach, you’ll spot opportunities rather than wait for a brief.
  • The ability to operate at both strategic and executional level, from defining the annual VIP strategy to picking up the phone to a stylist.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • TALA is increasingly seen on the right people.
  • We have a strong and growing network of A-list and culturally relevant VIPs who genuinely want to wear and engage with TALA.
  • TALA becomes a brand that celebrities, stylists and cultural tastemakers actively want to be associated with.
  • Our Ambassador and Pro programmes become recognised as some of the most exciting programmes in the category.

  • TALA earns more high-quality PR and cultural coverage.

Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

About the Role

Ramp's Accounting Channel is a key growth driver for the company, and we're looking for a founding Channel Partner Manager to help build our UK accounting-partner motion from the ground up. As an early member of the team in London, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Ramp partners with accounting and advisory firms across the region; building the relationships, go-to-market strategy, and repeatable motions that fuel long-term growth.

This role is for someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and takes ownership without being handed a playbook. You'll acquire and grow relationships with accounting and advisory partners, enable their teams, and generate revenue through client referrals. You'll also help us adapt Ramp's partner strategy to the commercial and cultural nuances of the UK markets.

What You'll Do

  • Source, qualify, and conduct deep discovery with net-new accounting and advisory partners across the UK

  • Sign partners and build comprehensive go-to-market plans that create a scalable referral motion

  • Drive revenue for Ramp by generating and converting client referrals from accounting firms

  • Build relationships with multiple stakeholders within partner firms, from firm leadership to client-facing teams

  • Educate partners on Ramp's offering and clearly articulate the value we deliver to both their firms and their clients

  • Enable and onboard partner team members so they can confidently identify, position, and refer Ramp

  • Hold monthly and quarterly business reviews with key partners; use performance data and feedback to identify new growth opportunities

  • Adapt your approach to the cultural, commercial, and regulatory nuances of the UK accounting landscape

  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, growth, direct sales, and product and engineering to develop co-marketing opportunities, onboard referred clients, and inform the product roadmap

  • Become an expert in Ramp's product, features, and workflows

  • Build new (and improve existing) workflows, sales motions, and partner programs that contribute to the team's continued success

  • Own partner activity, pipeline, forecasts, and revenue targets with disciplined follow-through and CRM hygiene

  • AI fluency as a daily habit. Ramp is a builder culture: if you don't instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment

  • Strong discovery skills and a consultative approach to uncovering partner pain points and growth opportunities

  • A track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets and quotas

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to operate with high autonomy in a fast-paced, evolving environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong listening and stakeholder-management skills

  • Proven ability to build relationships with senior and day-to-day stakeholders, both externally and across the company

  • Ability to work five days per week from our London office, with willingness to travel across the UK

  • Experience partnering with accounting firms in a consulting, sales, or partnerships capacity

  • Knowledge of the UK accounting and advisory ecosystem

  • Background or proficiency in accounting

  • Experience launching a new territory, vertical, or partner program

  • Fluency in additional European languages

  • Prior CRM experience, preferably Salesforce

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Recommendations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3><strong>What does the team work on?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the No. 1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with 70+ million active accounts. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The depth of query, content, and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness on the search and discovery journey, and this team owns the models that power it across the Roku platform.</p> <h3><strong>What is the role?</strong></h3> <p>The depth of query, content and user understanding using ML is key to user happiness in their search journey. Solving this customer problem is why we’re actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search &amp; Recommendations to drive further innovation in search and discovery. The person in this role will leverage their technical skills, business intuition, and analytical thinking to build best-of-class AI-powered products. Communication and presentation skills are important. The role requires both high technical acumen and problem-solving abilities, motivation, and exceptional attention to detail. Every day, you’ll look at what exists and find ways to make it better.</p> <h3><strong>How will I use AI at Roku?</strong></h3> <p>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p><strong>We value</strong> your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <h3><strong>What are the responsibilities of the role?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Apply state of the art ML on search using techniques in deep learning, bandits, transformers, LLMs, causal inference, and optimisations to make our users more delighted and engaged on the platform</li> <li>Run online AB tests and analyse them against the critical business KPIs</li> <li>Collaborate with US engineering teams as well as cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications</li> <li>Nurture our ML ecosystem to make it withstand scale, developer velocity and future business shifts</li> <li>Provide technical leadership to drive technical and ML roadmap for search ranking and monetisation</li> <li>Help in recruiting new engineers. Interview, train, and mentor new team members</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience (or PhD with 6 years of experience) applying Machine Learning to concrete problems at large-scale in domains like recommendation or search or ads</li> <li>Strong CS fundamentals. Should be able to convert ideas to code with ease</li> <li>Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals like classification, deep neural nets, and sequence-based models. Familiarity with modern NLP stack and multi-modal representation learning is a plus</li> <li>We’d love to see that you’ve worked with big data systems (Spark, S3, and Airflow) and can program (Java, Scala, or Python)</li> <li>Good understanding of system architecture. Have experience in big data technologies and streaming architecture, data pipelines, etc.</li> <li>Demonstrated AI/agentic-tooling fluency per the section above</li> <li>MS in Computer Science, Statistics, or related field, but a Ph.D. in CS or related fields is preferred</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-MS3</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice.
